comparator.name: cmp4 = the honest v4 package (the one pre-registered comparator; V6_V10_PLAN 7.1 item 10 b)
comparator.why: the latest KEPT version is v4 (data/derived/version_history.json), which has no predict(); its package is the composition vault audit 1 scored as 'predict() v4 base' and V6_V10_PLAN 4.1 names (v4 + blend_anchor): the MoE expert stack by line regime with the v4 simulator as the engine expert, methodround S / SM cells pooled with the simulator's cells. It runs on the same engine file as v7, so the two packages share one simulator (common random numbers) and the contrast isolates the package parts (cycle 1 in C1; cycles 1 + 2 in the reported primary contrast).
comparator.definition: versions/v7 engine with params.blend overridden to { winner 'stack', mrModel 'S', debut false, statDist false, props off } (tools/predict_harness.js CMP4_BLEND); lineKind close -> the close-trained `model` block with the closing line (methodround SM cells), open -> the open-trained `model_open` block with the opener (S cells), none -> the absent block (S cells); MoE experts from tools/predictrec.js (2019-2023: ML v1 annual OOF, feature LR expanding-window OOF, Elo, market rating; the engine expert = this simulator, both corner orders, in predict)
comparator.honest_inputs: per-year stackers data/derived/v7/cmp_stack_v4pkg_fit<Y-1>.json refit by tools/blindtest.py export --fit-through <Y-1>-12-31 with BLINDTEST_MOE_ENGINE_TRAIN=v7 BLINDTEST_MOE_ENGINE=engine_v7, i.e. on engine rows of THIS simulator rebuilt with the fold-honest learned-rate table (data/derived/evalv/v7_train.json: tools/evalv.js --version v7 --split train, mlrates_oof_fh.json; the v4 engine has no embedding recipe); both packages get the same honest inputs (one engine directory, one input pipeline). 2019-2020 rows use the fit through 2020 (flagged inSample) and only feed the pool-weight fit.
comparator.pool_weight: the comparator's w is refit forward-chained exactly like v7's (tools/v7_gate.py: fit on 2019..Y-1, no-line joint log loss, grid 0.05), not frozen

refit_schedule.gate: annual for both packages: ML v2 annual out-of-fold rows and stack weights fit on 2019..Y-1 (v7); ML v1 annual expanding OOF, feature LR expanding-window OOF and MoE stackers fit on 2019..Y-1 (cmp4); S2 cells fit on years < Y (v7), methodround S / SM fit through Dec 31 of Y-1 (cmp4); the rating filters (Elo, market rating) are walk-forward features in both
